research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cloudinary is researching systems, devices, and methods for improved encoding and enhanced compression of images, videos, and media content. The work focuses on analyzing source images on a pixel-by-pixel basis and classifying each pixel to optimize compression. This research and development centers on advancing media processing techniques to support efficient delivery and management of visual experiences.

overview_description.description: Cloudinary empowers the world’s top brands to deliver visual-first experiences that engage and convert. Founded in 2012 and with offices in the US, UK and Israel, Cloudinary’s cloud-based solutions for image and video management and digital asset management (DAM) harness AI-based technologies to remove traditional media management pain-points and allow brands to focus on delivering optimal digital experiences faster, no matter where their customers are engaging. Cloudinary has nearly 30 billion assets under management and 5,500 customers worldwide, including Apartment Therapy, Bleacher Report, Conde Nast, DoorDash, Forbes, HelloFresh, Hinge, Lululemon Athletica, NTT Resonant, Procter & Gamble, StubHub, trivago, Under Armour, Walmart Labs and more. For more information and to begin your Cloudinary experience, visit www.cloudinary.com.

product.name: Cloudinary Platform
product.description: An API-driven cloud platform for uploading, storing, managing, transforming, optimizing, and delivering images and videos across websites, applications, and digital channels.

product.name: Cloudinary Image
product.description: A cloud-based image management and delivery product for transforming, personalizing, optimizing, and serving images for different devices, channels, and use cases.

product.name: Cloudinary Video
product.description: A video management and delivery product that provides transcoding, editing, accessibility features, optimization, and delivery for web and mobile experiences.

product.name: Cloudinary Assets
product.description: An AI-powered digital asset management product for centralizing, organizing, searching, governing, moderating, and distributing images, videos, and other media assets.

product.name: Cloudinary AI
product.description: AI capabilities for generating, editing, analyzing, moderating, and automating image and video workflows through Cloudinary APIs and platform tools.

product.name: Cloudinary MediaFlows
product.description: A low-code workflow automation product for building and operating image and video processing workflows across Cloudinary and connected systems.
